name: codex-usage-monitor
description: Persist and report token usage and estimated cost across local Codex sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent token and cost records for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Tracks every local Codex session in SQLite and reports input, cached input, cache writes, output, reasoning tokens, and configurable cost estimates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my saved Codex usage records and estimated cost.
